notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay improvements.
notes.notes:
Hungrities 1.2.0 
In this patch, the following points have been fixed, modified, and added:

Bug fix: Resolved an issue when attempting to capture a creature in the presence of many on the map.

Modification of in-game volume and specific audio elements.

Modification of creature damage dealt by creatures, and adjustment of damage received by creatures when the negative night event is active.

Modification of the button to access the creature collection.

Implementation of a credits menu upon game launch.
